goal: must fix the presets tree inspection command so a project initialized by setup shows installed plugin presets, not only the built-in base preset.

analysis.problem: Issue #388 reports that setup can install and resolve official presets such as nextjs, but `senti presets list` still prints only the built-in `base` tree. This makes the presets tree look broken after setup even though runtime preset resolution works.
analysis.proposedApproach: Make the presets listing path use the same project-aware preset inventory that runtime resolution uses, while preserving the built-in base-only fallback for projects without enabled preset plugins.
analysis.validation: Verify the command in a project with an installed official-presets plugin and in a base-only project. The plugin-backed case must include inherited nodes such as base, webapp, js-webapp, and nextjs. The base-only case must still print base. Retained public output behavior must be verified for root and branch formatting, labels, aliases, scan markers, and template availability markers.

must preserve setup candidate resolution because `listSetupWizardPresetCandidates` already builds a full official preset tree.
must preserve runtime resolver behavior because `resolveChain('nextjs', projectRoot)` already resolves `base > webapp > js-webapp > nextjs` when the plugin registry is installed.
must account for `src/presets-cmd.js` currently importing `PRESETS`, which contains only core built-in presets.
must keep the fix focused on `senti presets list`; the user approved the flow scope for Issue #388 with setup candidate and runtime resolver changes out of scope.

should include behavior-level regression coverage for both plugin-backed and base-only display.

qa.question: この修正は must `senti presets list` の表示だけを対象にし、setup candidate や runtime resolver の仕様変更は対象外、という理解でよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。must `senti presets list` の表示経路だけを修正対象にし、setup candidate と runtime resolver の仕様変更は対象外にする。
qa.evidence: Issue #388 states setup candidate and runtime resolver already resolve `nextjs` as `base > webapp > js-webapp > nextjs`; the user selected auto mode for the displayed scope that named those areas out of scope.
qa.why: 問題は setup 後の tree inspection output に限定されており、動作済みの resolver へ変更を広げると blast radius が増えるため。

qa.question: plugin-backed project での受け入れ条件は must `nextjs` の親チェーン `base > webapp > js-webapp > nextjs` が tree 表示に現れること、で十分ですか。
qa.answer: はい。must plugin-backed project で `base`, `webapp`, `js-webapp`, `nextjs` が継承 tree として表示されることを受け入れ条件にする。should 他の official preset sibling も registry 由来で表示されることを確認する。
qa.evidence: Issue #388 gives `nextjs` as the concrete reproduction target and expected chain; local investigation confirmed setup candidate output includes `webapp > js-webapp > nextjs`.
qa.why: `nextjs` は broken tree を再現する最小の leaf preset で、parent chain 表示の成否を behavior-level に検証できるため。

qa.question: plugin registry を読めないプロジェクトでは should 既存どおり base-only 表示にフォールバックし、fatal error にしない方針でよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。should plugin registry を読めない場合は既存の base-only 表示へフォールバックし、`presets list` 自体は失敗させない。
qa.evidence: `src/lib/presets.js` has projectRoot-aware registry loading that can fall back to core presets when strict loading is not requested; current `presets list` already works in base-only mode.
qa.why: inspection command は未設定プロジェクトや package-local 実行でも使われるため、registry がないだけで fatal にすると既存利用を壊すため。
